subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The First Automobile
description: Learn The First Automobile in one minute.

hook.text: In 1886, Karl Benz built a three-wheeled machine that most people called a useless toy.

buildup.text: He had spent years shrinking a gasoline engine small enough to sit on a carriage frame.

discovery.text: His Patent-Motorwagen became the first true car—a vehicle driven by an internal engine.

twist.text: Almost nobody bought one. People trusted horses far more than loud, smelly machines.

climax.text: Then Bertha Benz secretly drove it 65 miles to prove it worked—the first road trip ever.

punchline.text: One bold drive changed how the world saw cars.

quiz.question: Who made the first long-distance car trip?
